name: Tlaloc

domain_history.domain: rain, water, and thunder deity; ruler of the Tlaloque (subordinate rain/mountain spirits); among the oldest continuously-attested Mesoamerican deities, with iconographic roots traceable to Teotihuacan, predating the Mexica

notes: Co-occupied the Templo Mayor's twin-shrine summit alongside Huitzilopochtli — a documented statement of the state pairing an ancient, regionally shared agricultural deity with the newer Mexica-specific war/imperial patron.
